description: This file implements authentication logic for a gateway, including handling of different auth modes (token, password, trusted-proxy, none), rate limiting, and verification of Tailscale identities. It provides functions to authorize gateway connections over HTTP and WebSocket, with support for trusted proxies and Tailscale integration.

methods.name: normalizeLogin
methods.description: Normalizes a Tailscale login string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Extracts a string value from header input, handling string, array, or undefined.

methods.name: resolveTailscaleClientIp
methods.description: Resolves the client IP address from an IncomingMessage, considering trusted proxies.

methods.name: isLocalDirectRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request is a direct local request based on headers and socket address.

methods.name: getTailscaleUser
methods.description: Extracts Tailscale user info from request headers.

methods.name: hasTailscaleProxyHeaders
methods.description: Checks if request headers indicate a Tailscale proxy request.

methods.name: isTailscaleProxyRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request is a Tailscale proxy request based on headers and remote address.

methods.name: resolveVerifiedTailscaleUser
methods.description: Verifies Tailscale user identity via WHOIS lookup and proxy headers.

methods.name: resolveGatewayAuth
methods.description: Resolves the effective gateway authentication configuration based on inputs and environment.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSharedGatewayAuth
methods.description: Returns shared auth secret if mode is token or password, otherwise null.

methods.name: assertGatewayAuthConfigured
methods.description: Validates that the resolved auth configuration is properly set up, throws errors if not.

methods.name: authorizeTrustedProxy
methods.description: Checks if a request from a trusted proxy is valid and extracts user identity.

methods.name: shouldAllowTailscaleHeaderAuth
methods.description: Determines if Tailscale header auth is allowed based on auth surface.

methods.name: authorizeTrustedProxyBrowserOrigin
methods.description: Validates browser origin headers for trusted proxy requests.

methods.name: authorizeTokenAuth
methods.description: Verifies token-based authentication, comparing provided tokens and applying rate limits.

methods.name: authorizeGatewayConnect
methods.description: Main function to authorize a gateway connection, handling different auth modes, proxies, and rate limiting.

methods.name: authorizeGatewayConnectCore
methods.description: Core logic for gateway connection authorization, used internally.

methods.name: authorizeHttpGatewayConnect
methods.description: Wrapper to authorize HTTP gateway connections with default auth surface.

methods.name: authorizeWsControlUiGatewayConnect
methods.description: Wrapper to authorize WebSocket control UI gateway connections with specific auth surface.
